names.note: saint.gr prints the name in Latin letters in both the listing and the page heading, «Άγιος Eata του Hexham», and gives no Greek form of it; the form is copied as printed, with the rank word and the place left off.

death.note: saint.gr: «Κοιμήθηκε το 686 μ.Χ. και θάφτηκε κοντά στην Εκκλησία του Wilfrid στο Hexham»; its heading prints «(; - 686)».

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Eata του Hexham»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2701/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(; - 686)». The name is recorded as the page prints it, in Latin letters, because the page prints no Greek form — nothing here transliterates. The line calls him «του Hexham» and the narrative makes him abbot of Melrose and founder of Ripon, so `types` has `abbot` and no `office` is proposed, the page naming no see. Aidan is cross-referenced to 31 Αυγούστου and has no folder in the corpus, so he is named without a link. No coordinate, no hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
